changelog: PERMANENT UPDATER FIX: update packages now use immutable commit-pinned URLs instead of mutable main-branch package URLs.
Updater now retries checksum verification once to handle stale network/CDN responses.
Trusted immutable Pickle Que release packages can recover safely from a manifest checksum publishing mismatch after retry, while package version and operation validation remain enforced.
Fixed the 0-0-2 START MATCH overlay remaining visible after the match starts.
